description: Interface describing an auditable item stream.

dateCreated.description: The date/time of when the stream was created.

dateModified.description: The date/time of when the stream was modified.

organizationIdentity.description: The identity of the organization which controls the stream.

userIdentity.description: The identity of the user who created the stream.

annotationObject.description: The object to associate with the entry as JSON-LD.

proofId.description: The id of the immutable proof for the stream.

immutableInterval.description: After how many entries do we add immutable checks.

numberOfItems.description: How many entries are in the stream.

cursor.description: The cursor for the stream entries.
